summary: Design measurable leadership programmes with competency maps, evaluation tools, and rollout plans. Book expert-led training today.
lede: Leadership Development Programme Design training teaches you to turn leadership gaps, succession needs, and business priorities into a structured learning journey with measurable outcomes. You will learn to assess capability gaps, map competencies, design learning pathways, and align stakeholders around a practical programme blueprint. The course shows you how to create evaluation plans, scorecards, and dashboards that connect leadership development with behaviour change and business results. Using tools such as 360-degree feedback, training needs analysis, the 70-20-10 model, CIPP, Kirkpatrick evaluation, and succession planning matrices, you can move from fragmented ideas to an executable design.
audienceIntro: This Leadership Development Programme Design training is built for professionals who design, sponsor, support, or evaluate leadership capability initiatives and need a practical way to connect learning investments to business priorities.
prerequisites: To get the most from this course, you should have a working understanding of organisational learning, HR or talent processes, and basic programme planning. Familiarity with leadership competency models, performance reviews, or 360-degree feedback will help, but no coding or technical software expertise is required. You should bring a laptop for workshop exercises, and advanced concepts such as evaluation design and learning analytics will be taught at an operational application level rather than as technical engineering.
